Class AbandonedStation

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.AbandonedStation
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardInterface, Serializable
public class AbandonedStation extends Card implements Serializable
Class that manages the single card abandoned ship In order of position, starting from the leader, the trucker decides, checking the crew members requirement, if he/she wants to lose days of flight in exchange for goods. Only one trucker car take the station and is possible that nobody wants to take it
